Check Q3: 0.9995×0.999×0.9995×0.995 = compute: 0.9995×0.999=0.9985005; ×0.9995=0.9980010; ×0.995=0.99301... = 0.9930100. So 99.30% correct. Downtime 0.00699×720=5.03? No: 0.00699×720 = 5.0328? 0.007×720=5.04. Wait 0.00699×720 = 5.03. Student wrote 3.5 hours — error! Actually 0.00699×720 = 5.0328. So downtime should be 5.0 hours, student said 3.5. Arithmetic slip. (c): 1−0.000025=0.999975 → 99.9975% but requested two decimals: 100.00%? Precision: "percentages to two decimal places" — 99.9975% → 100.00%? Hmm, 99.9975 rounds to 100.00. Downtime 0.018 h → 0.0 hours to one decimal. Student gave 0.018 hours, not to one decimal. Also (c) downtime: 0.000025×720=0.018 correct. Minor precision issues. One arithmetic slip (b) → Proficient 6? Method correct, one arithmetic slip → 6.

Q4: Circuit breaker — states mixed up: "In the Open state calls pass through normally" — wrong; Open means calls fail. "If they succeed it opens again, otherwise it stays closed" — reversed. Explanation incorrect → Developing 1-2. Give 2.

Q5: CAP explained incorrectly ("choose consistency and availability, give up partition tolerance" — P is not optional). Techniques: Redis TTL for menu; for payments no concrete technique named? They mention nothing concrete for payments. Proficient 3-4: one technique missing + CAP imprecise → 3.

Q1: availability response measure "stay up most of the time" not measurable → Proficient 4.

Q2: excellent, two scenario-specific trade-offs, downside acknowledged → 5-6. Give 6? Trade-offs specific, downside acknowledged. 6.

Q6: ADR has Context, Decision, Consequences but only positive consequences, no negative → Proficient 3-4 → 4? Consequences one-sided → 3-4; context specific → 4.

C7: Q2 exceeds 150 words (~200). Q4 also long (~180). References only [1],[2] cited but [2] not in reference list! Reference list missing [2]. Several issues → Developing 1-2 → 2.
